rows.en: ...Are you the envoy from the Vegan Empire?
It is a pleasure to meet you, Emperor Burai.
Hmph... You come to invade Earth, then ask us for an alliance? How very convenient for you.
You would do well to watch your tongue.
What?!
I am Zuril... the Vegan Empire's science chief, and its ambassador with full authority to negotiate this alliance.
As their envoy, my words are to be taken as the words of King Vega himself.
You bastard... You don't seem to understand your position...!
Wait, General Hidler...
rows.notes: Ignored documented stray closing wrapper and trailing line-break debris.

rows.en: Chief Zuril, is it? First, I must honestly commend your skill in finding this elusive fortress island.
I am honored, Emperor Burai. But with the Vegan Empire's scientific capabilities, it was a simple matter.
...In other words, you could have attacked this fortress island if you had wanted to?
Well, well... You are most perceptive...
Y-you scoundrel! Are you trying to threaten us?!
Surely you jest. If we attacked the mighty Hyakki Empire, we would not escape unscathed either.
Besides, as I said earlier, we seek an alliance.

rows.notes: Retained deliberate silence.

rows.en: After all, we have a common thorn in our sides.
Gwahahahaha! You had the nerve to come to this fortress island alone... I must say, I am impressed.
You flatter me.
And there is reason in what you say.
Th-then, Emperor Burai...!
rows.notes: Retained trailing reaction fragment.

rows.en: Chief Zuril... As you say, Earth is teeming with enemies common to both us and the Vegan Empire.
The wretched humans... and their vanguard, #部隊名.
rows.notes: Humans and their vanguard refer to the common enemies named in row22. Retained deliberate nominal answer identifying enemies.

rows.en: Exactly. Those #部隊名 pests have power we cannot dismiss, even among the frail humans.
As you propose, it might be amusing for us to join forces to defeat them.
As expected of Emperor Burai, ruler of the Hyakki Empire. Your boldness and caliber exceed even your reputation.
...But I am not the sort to trust a man who is all talk.
I understand. Then allow us to demonstrate our power at once.
Our reconnaissance units report that Getter Robo has now returned to the Saotome Institute.
And it is operating separately from #部隊名's main force.
rows.notes: Subject is Getter Robo from row29.

rows.en: Oh... The timing is excellent.
The gift I brought... our energy-blocking field technology looks set to prove useful right away.
rows.notes: Uses central stage30_terms_additions.json source-literal term; no invented mechanism or historical operation.
uncertain: Independent licensed English label unverified; Japanese term corroborated by central stage30_terms_additions.json.

rows.en: Hm... Did you say an energy-blocking field?
rows.notes: Uses central stage30_terms_additions.json source-literal term; no invented mechanism or historical operation.
uncertain: Independent licensed English label unverified; Japanese term corroborated by central stage30_terms_additions.json.

rows.en: It requires a fair amount of power, so only large units can carry it, but I have an interesting use in mind.
And what use might that be?
I call it "Operation Heavy Bomber Suicide Strike"!
rows.notes: Uses central stage30_terms_additions.json source-literal term; no invented mechanism or historical operation.
uncertain: Independent licensed English label unverified; Japanese term corroborated by central stage30_terms_additions.json.

rows.en: Interesting... We can take our time seizing the Getter Ray amplifier after we annihilate the Saotome Institute.
Above all, if we destroy the institute before Getter Robo's very eyes, they will learn just how helpless they are.
I shall see what you can do, Chief Zuril.
Then I shall borrow your workshop to make the preparations.
Very well. Dr. Gura, show him the way.
Yes, sir! ...Please, this way.
I am honored to be guided by Dr. Gura himself, said to be the finest mind of the Hyakki clan.
Not at all... I look forward to seeing the very essence of the Vegan Empire's scientific prowess.
Heh heh heh... This should be quite a sight.
Emperor Burai! I must warn you about this alliance with them!
I know what you want to say. I do not trust the Vegan Empire either.
Then...!
rows.notes: Retained deliberately unfinished objection.

rows.en: Now wait, General Hidler. They too have circumstances that leave them no choice but to ally with us.
What do you mean?
The Vegan Empire's base is on the Moon...
rows.notes: Trailing ellipsis introduces explanation in row52.

rows.en: This alliance is likely also meant to keep Gulfer and Giganos in check, since they too are based on the Moon.
Those bastards, just as I thought... They mean to use us as their vanguard in conquering Earth...!
But our situation is no different. Tekkoryu has fallen, but a new organization called Gyandlar has begun to act.
Our reconnaissance units say they have mechanical bodies, much like Gulfer.
And Mu is waiting for its chance behind the barrier... There are plenty of others pursuing their own agendas, too.
Every one of them is surely incompatible with us.
Earth's balance of power is becoming as chaotic as the Moon's... No, even more so...
But this deadlock is also an opportunity, if you look at it the other way.
Whoever breaks free of it could seize supremacy in one stroke.
And that can only be us, the Hyakki clan!
Exactly. I intend to use anything I can to achieve that.
If the Vegan Empire means to use us as expendable pawns, we shall use them in turn.
To that end, do not take your eyes off him... off Zuril's movements.
rows.notes: Interrupted referent is explicitly clarified as Zuril.

rows.en: Hyakki, Buraaai!
rows.notes: Repeated salute in three original uses; retain elongated cry.
uncertain: Exact established English catchcry spelling unconfirmed.

rows.en: ...Everyone, I am sorry to have summoned you so suddenly.
Not at all... #部隊名's Nahel Argama unit was on standby at GEAR HQ anyway.
By the way, who are they?
rows.notes: They are the player leads escorting the Getter team, settled by rows68-69.

rows.en: We asked them to come along as our escorts, Father.
I'm sorry to impose. We'll be in your care for a while.
rows.notes: The female lead apologizes for imposing on the institute; no reversal of request direction.

rows.en: No, it is no trouble.
But, Doctor... Has something happened? You called us to the institute.
It looks like the Get Machines have been moved from the hangar to the factory, too...
rows.notes: Retained trailing observation pending the doctor explanation.

rows.en: Yes... With improvements to the Getter Ray control system, I intend to refit Getter as well.
Does that mean... Getter Robo is getting a power boost?
Yes, provided this refit plan succeeds, of course.
All right! That's Dr. Saotome for you!
...Research into Getter Rays advances every day.
True, I do not wish to use Getter Rays in combat, but...
rows.notes: Retained trailing contrast completed in row79.

rows.en: If they are used as a force to defeat evil, I believe that amounts to using them for peace.
Doctor...
rows.notes: Ryoma trails off in response to the doctor on peaceful use of Getter Rays.

rows.en: Father! They say a group of machines believed to be from the Hyakki Empire is approaching the institute!
Those bastards! They mean to attack Getter and the institute while #部隊名's main force is away...!
Doctor, what about the Get Machines!?
...Their routine maintenance is complete. I'm told they can sortie.
Let's go, Hayato, Benkei!
Yeah! As long as we're here, we won't let them lay a finger on the institute!
#女愛称, we're heading out too!
Yes, understood!
rows.notes: Also used at s06e10:307; affirmative response to the lead asking to hold out until Nahel Argama arrives.

rows.en: Me! Number one in the Commander Ranking! Beaten?!
uncertain: Source is a defeat cry with no verb ('This me, No. 1 in the Commander Ranking...!'); 'Beaten?!' supplied from the context of a defeat line. 'Commander Ranking' from glossary term [jp].

rows.en: Nuuuoooh! Me... How could I, of all people...?!
uncertain: Source is a bare 'Me... this me?!' defeat cry; 'How could I' supplies the implied disbelief.

rows.en: Rom!!
Mark my words! I shall return!
uncertain: [jp] is English in katakana; rendered as plain English.

rows.en: Lord Gades, I served you faithfully! Why won't you come to save me?!
uncertain: ガデス様 rendered 'Lord Gades'; assumed the line is addressed to Gades (rescue plea).

rows.en: Ah, no! My Commander Ranking's gonna drop!
uncertain: Kansai-dialect comic line ('[jp]'); dialect conveyed only through casual register.

rows.en: Milady! Master Rom! I am terribly sorry!
uncertain: お嬢様 = Leina (Jim is Leina's servant) -> 'Milady'; ロム様 -> 'Master Rom'.

rows.en: What has justice ever done for me? Justice does nothing for anyone...
uncertain: くれる object not stated; 'for me' / 'for anyone' chosen.

rows.en: Pass this on! Tell them I fought a battle no martial artist would be ashamed of!
uncertain: 伝えてくれ has no stated recipient; kept unnamed ('Tell them'). Likely meant for Rom, not asserted.

rows.en: Brother Rom! I'm sorry!
Wh-wh-whoa! Rooom~!
I'm counting on you to carry on!
uncertain: 後を頼む: Rom asks the listener (his allies) to take over; listener not named.

rows.en: Unable to continue combat...
They got me?! No way!!
uncertain: やられた has no subject; 'They got me' (agent unspecified).

rows.en: Ah... Aaah?!
N-no way... Is this as far as I go...?!
Y-you're kidding! Me, of all people?! I can't believe it!
Ugh! I can't be like this... I just can't let it end like this!
uncertain: [jp]: the 'I' is inferred (Asuka berating herself).

rows.en: Yes... That's how it should be......

uncertain: speaker_en was empty; filled from glossary ＥＶＡ量産機 = 'Mass-produced EVA'.

rows.en: I'll leave your fate be... for now!
uncertain: [jp] (retreat line): 'I'll hold off on your fate for a while'.

rows.en: Careless of me... Is this the end...?!
Damn, is this as far as I go?!
No...! It can't be, not this!!

uncertain: speaker_en was empty; ガルファ speaker filled as 'Gulfer' (glossary term ガルファ, do_not_touch). Probably the generic Gulfer soldier unit (ガルファ素体 = 'Gulfer Soldier'); kept the shorter in-game label.

rows.en: O-Oyakata-samaaa!
uncertain: お館様 kept as 'Oyakata-sama' per glossary term.

rows.en: Wh-what?! Impossible!!
Th-this can't... This is absurd...!!
It's no good! I have to bail out!
uncertain: 脱出しないと has no subject; 'I' inferred (Kirakuni flies the Cell Fighter; not verified that it is solo).

rows.en: We have to... bail out...!
uncertain: 脱出しなきゃ has no subject; 'We' inferred because Dendoh is co-piloted by Ginga and Hokuto. This line is reused in 3 places (s00r00:32/33/173) and may play when Hokuto is in another unit - check.

rows.en: Is this the end...?!
Nuooooooh!!
It seems retreat is my only choice...!
uncertain: [jp]: subject inferred as 'my' (Vega speaking for herself); could be 'our' if she leads a group.

rows.en: Your Majesty, Gulfer Emperor... Please... forgive me...
uncertain: [jp] -> 'Your Majesty, Gulfer Emperor' using glossary 'Gulfer Emperor' (note: glossary en_short for that entry is 'Galfa Emperor', inconsistent with en_full/do_not_touch 'Gulfer').

rows.en: B-bailing out~! Ryoko, don't get mad at me, okay?!
uncertain: 脱出 has no subject; rendered as 'bailing out' (Hikaru herself).

rows.en: Curses...! Hurry, all hands, evacuate!
Dammit! Is this how it ends?!
Wha! This is as far as I go?! How pathetic...!
uncertain: ここまでかよ / 情けねえ: subject 'I' inferred (Saburota about himself).

rows.en: Yu... Yurika......
In death, none shall gather my bones... To perish is my fate...
uncertain: [jp] is a stock oath phrase ('none will gather the corpse of the fallen'); rendered with 'my' since he is speaking of himself.

rows.en: Omoikane... I'm sorry. All hands, abandon ship!
This is the end... and that's a wrap...
uncertain: 一巻の終わり ('end of the scroll' = 'it's all over'); Izumi is a punster, 'that's a wrap' keeps the media idiom.

rows.en: Ngh! Next time, victory will be ours!
Uwaah! Captain, sir!!
uncertain: 大尉殿 = Meio (captain) -> 'Captain, sir'.

rows.en: Dammit, you'll pay for this! You Dragonar scum!!
uncertain: 覚えていろ rendered 'you'll pay for this' (stock threat).

rows.en: Uoooooh?!
D-dammiiiit!!
Take care of my mom for me...!!
uncertain: 頼んだぜ: Kaine asks the listener (unnamed) to look after his mother; direction kept as a request.

rows.en: C-Colonel!!
uncertain: 大佐 = Gon Jem (colonel).

rows.en: What?! Waaaah!!
It's no good! I'm bailing out!!
C-Captain, sirrr!
uncertain: 大尉殿 = Meio.

rows.en: As long as I live, the Giganos Empire shall never fall...!
uncertain: [jp] literally 'as long as I am here'; 'as long as I live' chosen.

rows.en: Heh, so this is as far as I go...
Tch, that's all for today!
uncertain: ここまで: impersonal 'that's all for today' kept (Min retreating).

rows.en: Sorry! This is as far as I go!
Am I going down...?!
Ngh, how could this...
uncertain: なんという… trails off in the source; kept the omission.

rows.en: Ah, no...!
Waaaah!! I-it's no good~
Judau! They got me!
No no no no!
Dammit! Sorry, I'm bailing out!
D-damn! They got me!
This is... the end...
N-no good! I've been hit!
Big brother...!
uncertain: Leina's brother is Judau; kept as 'Big brother' rather than naming him, matching the source.

rows.en: Aah, why did this happen to me of all people!?
uncertain: Source is the fragment 'why this me!?' (nande kono atashi ga); restored a verb ('happen to me').

rows.en: No good! I'm bailing out!
My unit's already done for!? Amuro...!
uncertain: Source 'mou kitai ga!?' omits the predicate; inferred 'already done for' (unit destroyed).

rows.en: So this is it... All hands, evacuate!
I... I lost...!
uncertain: Source 'maketa no ka' has no subject; restored 'I' (Argo about himself).

rows.en: Ugh! D-Domon!!
Hahaha... It's no use! You have no chance of winning...
You lot are finished no matter whaaat!
Splendid... Gwaaah!!
Ugh... ugh... I... I lost...!
uncertain: speaker_en was empty; filled 'Sai Saici' from glossary (speaker_jp is the short form 'Saishi').

rows.en: Ugh, guh, ah, aaaagh!
Alas... My fate, too, ends here...
Jeeesus! You gotta be kidding me!
Graaaaaah!!
Brrrrrr...
uncertain: Horse noise (Fuunsaiki); kept as 'Brrrrrr...'.

rows.en: Waaaaagh!
D-Domooon!!
You'd better remember this, you bastard!
Wh-whoa-whoaaa~
uncertain: Boss's comic exclamation 'arryaryaaan' has no fixed English; rendered as a goofy 'Wh-whoa-whoaaa~'.

rows.en: Noooo~! Koji~!
Daaamn iiit!
I'm bailing out!
Oh, come on. Whoa!?
Oh well. I'm counting on you for the rest, everyone.
uncertain: Direction: 'ato wa tanomu ze, minna' = Hayato asking everyone to handle the rest.

rows.en: Kyaaaah! Ryo! Hayato! Benkei!
rows.notes: Source nickname maps to Ryo per campaign_terms.json and https://srw.wiki.cre.jp/wiki/流竜馬; full 竜馬 remains Ryoma.
uncertain: Source says 'Ryou-kun' (nickname for Ryoma). No glossary entry for the nickname; used glossary short name 'Ryoma'. Could be 'Ryo' if the project prefers nicknames. Honorific -kun dropped.

rows.en: Don't think this means you've won!
E-Emperor Burai!
Getter's power is... Dammit!
uncertain: Kept the source's cut-off: 'Getter's power is...' (predicate omitted in JP, deliberately unfinished).

rows.en: J-Juniooor~!
uncertain: Zuril cries out 'Junior'; glossary has the unit 'Zuril Jr.'. Referent inferred to be his Zuril Jr.; kept as 'Junior' since that is what he shouts.

rows.en: King Vegaaaa!
uncertain: 'Vega Daiou-sama': honorific -sama not rendered separately; 'King' carries it.

rows.en: I am the king of the universe, King Vegaaa!
Kyaaaah! Kojiii!!
Kyaaaah!
Damn, I got careless! Me, of all people!
U-urgh... Jigajiga... Is this as far as we go...!
uncertain: 'Jigajiga' = his Vega Beast (glossary: Vega Beast Jigajiga). Restored subject 'we' (Mors + Jigajiga).

rows.en: I'm counting on you all to protect the Earth!
uncertain: Direction: Duke asking the others (kimitachi de) to protect Earth.

rows.en: Kyaaah!! Daisuke!
uncertain: Honorific -san dropped.

rows.en: Ooooh! Ugwaaaaaagh~!
I'm sorry... Miku...
Nuooooooh!!
No way! Zeorymer is going down!?
uncertain: Source 'masaka, Zeorymer ga!?' omits the predicate; inferred 'is going down' (unit-destroyed line).

rows.en: No way! Zeorymer is going down!?
uncertain: Same line as 363 (Masaki instead of Masato); same inferred predicate.

rows.en: Impossible...! Omzack... my "Lightning"!
uncertain: Glossary unit is 'Omzack of the Lightning' (character entry for Saiga says 'Thunder'); used 'Lightning' to match the unit name.

rows.en: Tau... I'm sorry... I... you...!
uncertain: speaker_en empty; filled 'Shi-Aen' from glossary (speaker_jp is short 'Aen'; glossary only has the full form). Kept source omission 'watashi wa... anata wo...!' (no verb); the intended verb is not settled out of context. 'Tau' used bare as in source; glossary full name Shi-Tau.

rows.en: Big sister...
uncertain: speaker_en empty; filled 'Shi-Tau' from glossary (speaker_jp is short 'Tau').

rows.en: Y-Yuratei...
...I was careless... I... have lost...
Saiga... I... end here...
uncertain: Source 'watashi wa... koko de...' omits the verb; inferred 'end here' (dying/defeat).

rows.en: Damn... A lifelong disgrace for Kyoshiro Yuzuki!
Damn!! It's no good!
Ugh! I've been hit!?
Kyaaaah!!
Not yet! Raideen! Whoa!
This... can't be...!
Damn, it's no good!!
Waaaaaah!!
Eek!! No...!! It can't be!!
Ah! Is this the end!?
Kyaaah!!
Graaaaaah!!
Kyaaah!!
Waaaaaah!!

uncertain: speaker_en was empty; filled 'Sai Saici' from glossary.

rows.en: Graaaaaah!!
Kyaaah!!
Uwaaagh!
uncertain: JP raw line lacks the closing bracket; translated the body only.

rows.en: 1. Destroy all enemies.
rows.notes: Player; victory objective; no dialogue referent. Decision: Restore settled subjects/actions in natural spoken English; preserve tone and row boundary.

rows.en: 1. An enemy unit enters Saotome Institute@2. Any allied unit is shot down
rows.notes: Defeat conditions; retain two segments and both numbered conditions.

rows.en: So that is Saotome Institute, where they collect Getter Rays.
That's right, Minister Zuril. We've attacked it countless times, but...
rows.notes: Minister preserves explicit title; source-short Zuril.

rows.en: Each time, that hated Getter Robo and its allies have stopped us...
rows.notes: Deliberate sentence continuation from row91.

rows.en: But today, those allies are absent too. Defeat Getter Robo, the Hyakki Empire's sworn enemy, and crush the institute.
Very well. Leave it to me.
rows.notes: Hidler accepts Zuril's order; the listener is to leave the task to Hidler.

rows.en: So you've come out, Getter! Today, I'll make that institute your tombstone!
Damn! The Hyakki Empire and the Vegan Empire have joined forces!
They're two of a kind. I suppose they found some way to get along...!
rows.notes: The two enemy factions are the referent; no individual gender inferred.

rows.en: We have to beat them either way. Let's thank them for showing up together.
But can we really defend it with just us?
I've already contacted the Nahel Argama. They'll rush over here right away.
Then should we avoid taking risks and concentrate on defending the institute...?
Now, General Hidler, shall we sit back and enjoy the spectacle?
rows.notes: Zuril proposes that both commanders watch from safety.

rows.en: Yes. We'll proceed as arranged.
H-hey! The Motherburn's gone off somewhere!
Are you saying this is some kind of trap...!?
That's the logical conclusion, but right now...
rows.notes: Deliberate trailing contrast continues into Hayato's response.

rows.en: Yeah. We've got to do something about that giant Hyakki robot.
They're coming, Ryo!
rows.notes: Source nickname Ryo; speaker prefill Ryoma remains unchanged.

rows.en: All right! Everyone, we'll defend Saotome Institute from them to the end!
So if the enemy gets in there, it's all over?
That's right! Let's go, #女愛称!
Damn...! The operation has failed. We have no choice but to retreat.
Wait, Minister Zuril! We must fight to the bitter end!
Any more fighting is pointless. Besides, today was only a preliminary skirmish...!
You'll pay for this, Getter Robo! We were just one step away from destroying the institute!
As long as we're here, we won't let you do as you please with the institute or the Earth!
...You tried to win with someone else's muscle? I guess that's all you demons amount to.
rows.notes: Fundoshi/sumo idiom rendered as winning with borrowed muscle; retains contempt for the demons. Final meaning review restored explicit context-settled subject and verb; no compression.

rows.en: Silence! This is just another of our strategies for crushing you!
Is that so? Then you'd better make sure those Vegans don't use you!
rows.notes: Vegans means Planet Vega's faction, not diet.

rows.en: Duke Fleed! Let me see what Grendizer can do!
You're not Barendos...! Who are you!?
My name is Zuril... I am Planet Vega's science minister.
rows.notes: Explicit science-chief title rendered science minister; established Zuril prefill preserved.

rows.en: So you're reinforcements from Planet Vega itself...!
rows.notes: Duke recognizes Zuril as reinforcements from Planet Vega; final restores explicit subject and verb.

rows.en: That's right, Duke Fleed. I'll offer your head and this planet to King Vega!
The Vegan Empire and the Hyakki Empire... So the villains have joined forces!
Are you awed!? Now you have no chance of winning!
What the hell are you talking about! Crushing you all at once will save us the trouble!
You just keep coming up with one stupid plan after another!
You dare call my plan stupid...!? I have the finest mind in the Vegan Empire!
Yeah, that's right! I don't know how great your mind is, but if you use it for evil, it can't amount to much!
Demons have teamed up with evil aliens? Birds of a feather really do flock together!
rows.notes: Kaine mocks the alliance; final restores explicit subject and verb in the opening question.

rows.en: You bastard! Don't lump our Hyakki clan in with the likes of those Vegans!!
rows.notes: Source directly insults the addressee and disparages the Vegans; both retained.

rows.en: ...What exactly do you mean by that, General Hidler!
Well... I, uh...
rows.notes: Deliberate stammered unfinished explanation.

rows.en: What, you're already falling out!? Then I'll send both of you to your graves at once!!
I'll shatter your evil bond with my fists!
Hmph... You're challenging me to hand-to-hand combat? What a barbaric man!
rows.notes: Zuril sneers at Domon for challenging him to hand-to-hand combat; final restores explicit subject and verb.

rows.en: Huh... This guy... Is he looking at my EVA...?
rows.notes: Source explicitly calls the opponent a guy; no gender inferred from name.

rows.en: Oh... I'd heard about it, but to think something like this actually exists! Earth's weapon systems are truly fascinating...
Damn... I can't believe our enemies have teamed up...!
Your fate is already sealed! We may have lost Yousaiki, but now we'll show you our true power!
The Hyakki Empire and the Vegan Empire are both good at dirty tricks!
Hmph... Dirty or cowardly, all that matters in battle is winning!
Oh... What an interesting energy reading. I'd very much like to acquire this machine.
I won't hand Zeorymer over to anyone. Especially not evil scum like you!!
Whatever strategy you use, as long as we have Getter Robo, we will never lose!
What a spirited woman. But it seems you were reckless to come against us!
This is the new model's first battle! You're a bit overqualified, but you'll be my opponents!
rows.notes: Preserve mistaken role-insufficiency expression using overqualified, a compliment, to set up row149 correction. Final meaning review restored explicit context-settled subject and verb; no compression.
uncertain: Wordplay adaptation: overqualified preserves the mistaken compliment and correction, but no exact English equivalent of yakubusoku exists.

rows.en: Wait, #男愛称! Calling them "overqualified" makes it a compliment!
rows.notes: Female lead corrects the male lead's mistaken compliment; adapts quoted Japanese idiom to the exact English word in row148.
uncertain: Wordplay adaptation: overqualified preserves the mistaken compliment and correction, but no exact English equivalent of yakubusoku exists.

rows.en: ...Forget the details!! Let's go, #女愛称!
rows.notes: Male lead evades the correction by rushing into action.

rows.en: Honestly! You're so good at covering things up with sheer bluster!!
H-hey! Did you see that just now!!
Yeah. That thing hasn't taken any damage...!
Impossible...! Is it different from the usual Hyakki robots!?
Could it have the ability to repair itself...!?
No, that's not it! That reading just now was...
rows.notes: Deliberately unfinished identification of the preceding energy reading.

rows.en: Everyone, can you hear me!?
Doctor! What on earth is going on!?
A kind of energy field surrounds that Hyakki robot.
rows.notes: Doctor identifies the field; following row160 compares it to the space monster.

rows.en: It appears to be the same kind as the field around the glowing space monster Tetsuya fought the other day.
rows.notes: The omitted referent is the energy field described in preceding owner159.

rows.en: No! Then our attacks will barely do anything to it!?
To make matters worse, that Hyakki robot seems to be packed full of explosives.
W-what!? Is that really true, Doctor!?
Yes, there's no doubt. We found that out by scanning it from here.
Then what the enemy's after is...!?
rows.notes: Question trails into166; retain unfinished realization.

rows.en: Are they going to crash it into the institute!?
rows.notes: Enemy ramming aim targets the Saotome Institute.

rows.en: Damn it! We can't let them do that!
!? Look out, Ryo!!
rows.notes: Source nickname Ryo; speaker prefill Ryoma elsewhere remains intact.

rows.en: Uwaaah!!
Hayato!
H-hey! Are you all right!?
Tch, I screwed up...! They got my leg...!
rows.notes: Hayato injured his leg, as223 and238 confirm.
Punctuation-only startled reaction retained.

rows.en: Pull back, Getter Team! We'll handle things here!
Don't be ridiculous, #男愛称.
What...?!
Hayato's right. You plan to take on something our attacks can't hurt, all by yourself?
rows.notes: Single machine opposition; copilot is not erased by all by yourself idiom.

rows.en: Wait, an injured copilot could slow the whole machine down...! Ours is a two-seater too, so we know!
rows.notes: Injured copilot can slow machine movement; male lead argues from own two-seat craft.

rows.en: That's right! Don't push yourselves, any of you three!
But we can't pull back here...!
That institute is as good as our own home to us...
Ryo...!
rows.notes: Source nickname is Ryo, distinct from prefilled Ryoma speaker.

rows.en: So we can't just stand by and let them destroy it!

If we can at least delay them, events should turn in our favor...

rows.notes: Source-short Plato preserved; no full-name expansion.

rows.en: Yes, sir...!
Grr... Damn Meio Plato... Playing his clever little games in front of His Excellency...!
rows.notes: Thought; hostile muttering and name Meio Plato retained.

rows.en: And His Excellency is no better...! At this rate, Giganos will...!
rows.notes: Thought ends deliberately unfinished; ignored stray source closing wrapper.

rows.en: We've cleared the atmosphere. We'll now set course for the Moon.
...It's nearly time for Operation Moonraker to begin.
rows.notes: Established glossary Operation Moonraker.

rows.en: Yes...
Giganos should be watching our movements closely now. All hands, Level 2 battle stations...
rows.notes: Order trails off on incoming threat; Level 2 battle stations convention.

1. Nadesico reaches its destination within 7 turns.

rows.en: Giganos' Metal Armor force is entering the area!
Heh, look at them all! They've got some nerve!
rows.notes: Ryoko reacts to swarm of approaching enemies; colloquial irritation.

rows.en: Damn it! We don't have time to deal with those guys right now!
We're serving as a decoy anyway... So we have little choice.
Yes. If we draw the enemy's attention, the other fleets can advance into lunar space more easily.
B-but, come on!
rows.notes: Interrupted protest; retained fragment.

rows.en: Ginga, our job doesn't end when we save Unicorn and Leo.
rows.notes: Source-short Data Weapons Unicorn and Leo.

rows.en: We're supposed to go into Giganos' space, too.
I-I know that, okay!
...Harry, how are our allied forces moving?
rows.notes: Body nickname Harry preserved while speaker prefill remains Hari elsewhere.

rows.en: Some fleets seem to have engaged Giganos' frontline forces... But the operation is proceeding largely as planned.
Understood. All right, everyone... Please launch.
Amuro, even if we're the decoy, we can't let them hold us up here any longer than necessary.
Right. We should put Nadesico's breakthrough ahead of fighting them.
The Gundam and a golden mobile suit...!
rows.notes: Recognition fragment, followed by Karl identifying pilots in next row.

rows.en: Captain! Could those be Amuro Ray and the Red Comet!?
rows.notes: s06s10 event4 introduction/orders. Karl addresses Captain Meio; identifies Amuro and Char through source Red Comet epithet.

rows.en: ...Most likely, yes.
rows.notes: s06s10 event4 introduction/orders. Context-settled subject and action preserved.

rows.en: Y-you mean the top aces of the Federation and the former Zeon are fighting side by side...!?
rows.notes: s06s10 event4 introduction/orders. Context-settled subject and action preserved.
Intentional silence. Meio silent under orders; silence deliberately retained.

rows.en: ...The Red Comet... Why is he taking up arms against us in Giganos?
rows.notes: s06s10 event4 introduction/orders. Private thought about Char; male pronoun grounded in Quattro profile.

rows.en: With Haman's Neo Zeon destroyed, the Zabi family's obsession should have died out.
rows.notes: s06s10 event4 introduction/orders. The Zabi family obsession is expected to end with defeat of Haman-led Neo Zeon.

rows.en: And yet, the man who sought to witness humanity's transformation...
rows.notes: s06s10 event4 introduction/orders. Deliberate sentence fragment continues into486; humanity transformation means Newtype evolution concept, without adding a source-absent named label.

rows.en: Why does he still lend his strength to #部隊名...?
rows.notes: s06s10 event4 introduction/orders. Continues subject established485; exact squad placeholder retained.

rows.en: Captain...!
rows.notes: s06s10 event4 introduction/orders. Vocative retained.

rows.en: Heh... As warriors, consider yourselves lucky to meet opponents like them.
rows.notes: s06s10 event4 introduction/orders. Context-settled subject and action preserved.

rows.en: All units! Block the shortest route through to the Moon and hold it to the death!
rows.notes: s06s10 event4 introduction/orders. Hold to the death preserved.

rows.en: We must not let #部隊名 into the heart of Giganos!
rows.notes: s06s10 event4 introduction/orders. Metaphoric heart of Giganos retained; exact squad placeholder.

rows.en: Yes, sir! Understood!
rows.notes: s06s10 event4 introduction/orders. Context-settled subject and action preserved.

rows.en: ...Ensign Makibi, how much time do we have?
rows.notes: s06s10 event4 introduction/orders. Source surname plus naval rank rendered Ensign Makibi per profile.

rows.en: About fifteen minutes! Any longer will interfere with the mission to rescue the Data Weapons!
rows.notes: s06s10 event4 introduction/orders. Context-settled subject and action preserved.

rows.en: B-but with that many enemies, breaking through in just fifteen minutes...!
rows.notes: s06s10 event4 introduction/orders. Deliberate shocked trailing construction retained.

rows.en: No, we have seven minutes.
rows.notes: s06s10 event4 introduction/orders. Seven minutes preserved, despite later Ruri eight-minute order; source distinction unchanged.

rows.en: What!?
B-but that's half the time!!
rows.notes: s06s10 event4 introduction/orders. Context-settled subject and action preserved.

rows.en: But you made a vow, didn't you? To those two Data Weapons...
rows.notes: s06s10 event4 introduction/orders. Question is to both boys about their vow; trails toward498.

rows.en: That you'd bring back Lagowe's data and save them, no matter what.
rows.notes: s06s10 event4 introduction/orders. Continues quoted promise from497; they will obtain Lagowe data and save both Data Weapons.

rows.en: Hokuto, Ginga... Whatever the situation, you have to give more than your best.
rows.notes: s06s10 event4 introduction/orders. More than best preserved, not reduced to do your best.

rows.en: You should have learned that from all your battles so far, shouldn't you?
rows.notes: s06s10 event4 introduction/orders. Context-settled subject and action preserved.

rows.en: Don't be afraid, Hokuto. We're here for both of you.
rows.notes: s06s10 event4 introduction/orders. Context-settled subject and action preserved.

rows.en: Kazuya...!
rows.notes: s06s10 event4 introduction/orders. Vocative retained.

rows.en: That's right, there's nothing to worry about. We'll clear the way for you.
rows.notes: s06s10 event4 introduction/orders. Context-settled subject and action preserved.

rows.en: You've got the Gundam Team on your side, after all! You can rest easy.
rows.notes: s06s10 event4 introduction/orders. Large-ship idiom rendered rest easy; explicit Gundam Team reassurance preserved.

rows.en: Hey, Judau! Don't you forget about us!
rows.notes: s06s10 event4 introduction/orders. Context-settled subject and action preserved.

rows.en: Oh... S-sorry, Ryoko.
rows.notes: s06s10 event4 introduction/orders. Context-settled subject and action preserved.

rows.en: Hokuto, Ginga... If you lose your nerve here, you won't be able to save Unicorn and Leo.
rows.notes: s06s10 event4 introduction/orders. Source-short Unicorn and Leo, not full unit names.

rows.en: That's right! We'll help too, so let's give it our all, okay?
rows.notes: s06s10 event4 introduction/orders. Ple joins the support group and asks the boys to try together; direction preserved.

rows.en: Everyone...!
rows.notes: s06s10 event4 introduction/orders. Emotional vocative retained.

rows.en: Everyone...!
rows.notes: s06s10 event4 introduction/orders. Emotional vocative retained.

rows.en: Let's go, you two. To the Moon...! To rescue the Data Weapons and destroy Giganos's mass driver!
rows.notes: s06s10 event4 introduction/orders. Context-settled subject and action preserved.

rows.en: Y-yes!
rows.notes: Same startled assent works at both uses, answering Vega at 305 and Rom at 326.

rows.en: Y-yes!
rows.notes: s06s10 event4 introduction/orders. Context-settled subject and action preserved.

rows.en: Everyone... Thank you...!
rows.notes: s06s10 event4 introduction/orders. Context-settled subject and action preserved.

rows.en: Well, now that we've renewed our resolve... Harry, where's the quickest point to break through this sector?
rows.notes: s06s10 event4 introduction/orders. Body nickname Harry distinct from speaker prefill Hari.

rows.en: Um, please wait... I've got it. Over there!
rows.notes: s06s10 event4 introduction/orders. Context-settled subject and action preserved.

rows.en: Hey, you're saying it's right in the middle of the enemy?
rows.notes: s06s10 event4 introduction/orders. Context-settled subject and action preserved.

rows.en: Well, we can't help that.
rows.notes: s06s10 event4 introduction/orders. Context-settled subject and action preserved.

rows.en: All right, everyone... The Nadesico will head for that point within eight minutes from now. Sorry, but I'm counting on you for cover.
rows.notes: s06s10 event4 introduction/orders. Ruri asks for covering support, does not offer her own support. Eight minutes preserved.

rows.en: All right! I'll show you there's no wall the great Rod Drill can't break down!
rows.notes: s06s10 event4 introduction/orders. Boast and source full Rod Drill retained.

rows.en: Don't get too carried away, Drill. Our job is to escort the Nadesico, after all...
rows.notes: s06s10 event4 introduction/orders. Context-settled subject and action preserved.

rows.en: There's no point in you going over there alone.
rows.notes: s06s10 event4 introduction/orders. Context-settled subject and action preserved.

rows.en: I know that without you telling me!
rows.notes: s06s10 event4 introduction/orders. Context-settled subject and action preserved.

rows.en: All units! Don't engage the interceptors! Prioritize destroying the enemy units massed at the target point!
rows.notes: s06s10 event4 introduction/orders. Do not engage interceptors; clear enemy concentration at objective first.

rows.en: Impossible...! Are you saying I had doubts in my heart...!?
rows.notes: s06s10 event5 defeat. Event5 defeat self-question, separate from introduction and event8 combat confrontations.

rows.en: Amuro Ray! You were confined by the Federation yourself! Why can't you see their stupidity!?
rows.notes: s06s10 event8 individual combat confrontation. Context-settled subject and action preserved.

rows.en: Then let me ask you! Do you think Giganos's methods will make the Earth a better place!?
rows.notes: s06s10 event8 individual combat confrontation. Context-settled subject and action preserved.

rows.en: You must have realized it too! The future of the Earth and the people living on it is heading into a dead end!
rows.notes: s06s10 event8 individual combat confrontation. Context-settled subject and action preserved.

rows.en: Who decided that!? A future forged through violence will only benefit a handful of people!
rows.notes: s06s10 event8 individual combat confrontation. Context-settled subject and action preserved.

rows.en: You've given yourself away, Red Comet! I no longer expect anything from you!
rows.notes: s06s10 event8 individual combat confrontation. Actual event8 source names Red Comet; addresses Quattro, not Amuro in preceding separate combat exchange.

rows.en: That's fine. What I must do is protect the next generation and their world...
rows.notes: s06s10 event8 individual combat confrontation. Context-settled subject and action preserved.

rows.en: Even if I don't rise up, someone will surely appear to lead humanity... No, the time will come for every individual to awaken!
rows.notes: s06s10 event8 individual combat confrontation. Self-corrects from a future leader to awakening of every person; both clauses retained.

rows.en: But the clouds of war hanging over humanity have already reached a point where we can take nothing for granted...
rows.notes: s06s10 event8 individual combat confrontation. Context-settled subject and action preserved.

rows.en: The time has come when the Earth cannot endure unless humanity is united under a firm will!
rows.notes: s06s10 event8 individual combat confrontation. Context-settled subject and action preserved.

rows.en: We'll make it endure! That's what #部隊名 is for!
rows.notes: s06s10 event8 individual combat confrontation. Restored we keep Earth enduring; squad purpose explicit.

rows.en: Blue Hawk of Giganos! You must realize, too, that this battle won't do the Earth any good!
rows.notes: s06s10 event8 individual combat confrontation. Canonical full epithet retained.

rows.en: This battle is the pain of draining the pus from the Earth! We must do it, even if it means making sacrifices!
rows.notes: s06s10 event8 individual combat confrontation. Pus metaphor and justification of sacrifices preserved without softening.

rows.en: Can you say that same thing to the faces of the people who'll be sacrificed!?
rows.notes: s06s10 event8 individual combat confrontation. Challenge asks whether Meio would repeat justification before actual victims.

rows.en: ...I can!
rows.notes: s06s10 event8 individual combat confrontation. Context-settled subject and action preserved.

rows.en: Then I won't hesitate to strike you down!
rows.notes: s06s10 event8 individual combat confrontation. Strike down threat retained.

rows.en: Boy! Do you also think the Earth Federation's methods are right!?
rows.notes: s06s10 event8 individual combat confrontation. Context-settled subject and action preserved.

rows.en: Of course not! To us Spacenoids, the Federation is a bunch of people who don't understand anything!
rows.notes: s06s10 event8 individual combat confrontation. Judau speaks as a Spacenoid; Federation criticism retained.

rows.en: Then why side with the Federation!? Why don't you use your power to change the world!?
rows.notes: s06s10 event8 individual combat confrontation. Context-settled subject and action preserved.

rows.en: I know...! I know the ugliness... the horror... and the sorrow of trying to change the world by force...!
rows.notes: s06s10 event8 individual combat confrontation. All three harms preserved: ugliness, horror, sorrow.

rows.en: You mean Haman Karn...!
rows.notes: s06s10 event8 individual combat confrontation. Full Haman Karn reference derived from sourced Haman entry.

rows.en: I made a vow back then! If someone like that ever appeared again, I'd stop them with my own hands!
rows.notes: s06s10 event8 individual combat confrontation. Judau resolves to stop future would-be forceful world changers himself; gender-neutral someone.

rows.en: Wake up! Why must people from Earth fight each other when the Earth is in danger!?
rows.notes: s06s10 event8 individual combat confrontation. Context-settled subject and action preserved.

rows.en: Kazuya Ryuzaki, the man who became a bridge between Earth and Baam... I know of you.
rows.notes: s06s10 event8 individual combat confrontation. Kazuya full name and Earth/Baam bridge relationship preserved.

rows.en: We can understand each other even when we're from different planets... So why...
rows.notes: s06s10 event8 individual combat confrontation. Deliberate why trails off; we subject restored in main assertion.

rows.en: The answer lies in the Federation's corruption! Why does an organization meant to represent the will of all humanity seek only Earth's benefit!?
rows.notes: s06s10 event8 Kazuya confrontation. Humanity includes Spacenoids in contrast to interests of Earth alone; source political distinction retained.

rows.en: As long as their rule remains unchanged, we will not lower the swords we've raised!
rows.notes: s06s10 event8 individual combat confrontation. Context-settled subject and action preserved.

rows.en: Kyoshiro, this is reckless! Your opponent is the Blue Hawk of Giganos!
rows.notes: s06s10 event8 individual combat confrontation. Context-settled subject and action preserved.

rows.en: Shut up, Nana! I've got something I want to say to this bastard!
rows.notes: s06s10 event8 individual combat confrontation. Shut up directive and contempt for opponent retained.

rows.en: As someone long gone said, "Man brings more calamities upon man than anything else!" Those are Pliny's words!
rows.notes: s06s10 event8 Kyoshiro confrontation. Deceased/past person retained as someone long gone; source-short Pliny confirmed by central campaign glossary and primary Natural History VII introduction. Quote freshly translated from original.

rows.en: What!?
rows.notes: s06s10 event8 individual combat confrontation. Two actual uses checked: Kyoshiro quotation reaction and later Rom challenge reaction. Neutral short shock fits both.

rows.en: Making people shed tears to set the world right is the height of folly! You should change your name from Hawk to Kite!
rows.notes: s06s10 event8 individual combat confrontation. Hawk-to-kite bird insult retained; folly accusation retained.

rows.en: Get out of the way, Blue Hawk!!
rows.notes: s06s10 event8 individual combat confrontation. Source-short Blue Hawk retained.

rows.en: We have to go to the Moon for Unicorn and Leo!
rows.notes: s06s10 event8 individual combat confrontation. Boys must go to Moon for the two Data Weapons.

rows.en: I don't know your circumstances, but we have our own reasons why we can't back down...!
rows.notes: s06s10 event8 individual combat confrontation. Meio concedes unknown boys circumstances but refuses retreat for own reasons.

rows.en: If you have something at stake, then fight with every last ounce of your strength!
rows.notes: s06s10 event8 individual combat confrontation. Fight to utmost/death-strength preserved.

rows.en: You aren't from Earth! Why do you side with #部隊名!?
rows.notes: Meio challenges extraterrestrial Rom; exact squad placeholder retained.

rows.en: Kenro's guidance... It means that justice lies there!
rows.notes: Kenro guidance signals justice, replying to why Rom supports squad.

rows.en: Fool! Look at the state Earth is in!
The Federation government's corruption brought about today's chaos! Giganos will bring the hammer of justice down upon it!
Is that truly for the good of the world!?
A world that floats on people's tears will eventually sink in them! You're only building that kind of world yourselves!
rows.notes: Keep linked floating/sinking-in-tears metaphor and accusation.

rows.en: Hmm...!
You're skilled...!
rows.notes: Meio recognizes Jet's sword skill; restore contextual you/skill.

rows.en: Heh... What a shame... To think someone who's lost his way could be this skilled...
rows.notes: Jet laments skilled opponent on wrong path; male gender supported by Meio profile.

rows.en: Silence! There is not a trace of doubt in my sword or my heart! That is the very source of my strength!
Then I'll put my own convictions into my sword and face you, too! Jeeet!
rows.notes: Convictions carried in sword; stretched character-name combat shout retained.

rows.en: What you're saying may indeed be right...
You agree with us? Then...
rows.notes: Interrupted inference after apparent agreement.

rows.en: Hear us out! That doesn't mean what you're doing is right!
As long as there are people behind us suffering because of Giganos, we'll fight!
We'll use this power to protect the world, not to change it!
rows.notes: Female lead completes fight-for-protection argument; restored we/use verb.

rows.en: ...Perhaps I should find out what that man truly intends...
rows.notes: Thought introduces inquiry into Quattro's real intent.

rows.en: ...Char Aznable... No, Quattro Bajeena... Can you hear me?
I am Captain Meio Plato of the Giganos military's Imperial Guard.

rows.notes: Silent startled reaction; no invented words.

rows.en: What is that man saying to Captain Quattro...!?
rows.notes: Kamille questions what Meio says to Quattro, not what Quattro says.
Silence while Meio identifies Char.

rows.en: If you can hear me, open a channel.
...What do you want with me?
Answer me... Why are you there?
The ghosts of the Zabi family who exploited Zeon Zum Deikun's ideals should already have perished...
rows.notes: Zabi ghosts means remnants of family, not literal supernatural confirmation; full name centrally sourced to Akurasu.

rows.en: So why do you stand against us?

rows.notes: Silence serves both scene-specific uses without added interpretation.

rows.en: ...Our United Empire Giganos is the sword that will cut down the corruption-breeding Federation and vanquish evil...
rows.notes: United Empire Giganos and evil-vanquishing sword retained.

rows.en: Anyone who glimpsed humanity's evolution in that great war ought to agree with us.
rows.notes: Humanity evolution alludes to Newtypes, but do not insert term absent source.

rows.en: ...You're moving too fast. What humanity needs now is to discern the course of the times, not a sudden revolution.
The course of the times?
Yes. The time any one person has is limited.
Those who fail to understand that and try to force impossible reforms will eventually perish...
Just like Jamitov Hymen and Haman Karn.
rows.notes: Example continuation of previous row; full names centrally sourced. Jamitov Hymen follows Akurasu SRW64 and Mobile Suit Z Gundam; preserve draft Hymem for audit.

rows.en: ...Are you saying our Giganos will follow the same path?
Yes. Your hammer only gives people fear and hatred...
Those who can't trust the next generation and try to do everything in their own generation will face that hammer instead.
rows.notes: Hammer image reverses prior claim of righteous judgment onto impatient reformers. Measured initial overflow compressed; all three propositions retained.

rows.en: Are you saying your #部隊名 will do that?
Exactly. Giganos's Mass Driver isn't a sword that vanquishes evil...
rows.notes: Mass Driver sentence deliberately continues into next row.

rows.en: It's nothing but a tool that senselessly cuts down the young shoots who will carry the next generation.
rows.notes: Tool subject restored while keeping young-shoots metaphor and next-generation responsibility.

rows.en: That's why I'm here... To stop people like you.
...Char...
rows.notes: Amuro's silent address to Char; thought=True.

rows.en: Then are you saying you'll become the foundation for the next generation?
Will you abandon your destiny, defy your bloodline, and bury yourself in the present age?
rows.notes: Meio accuses Char of abandoning destiny and lineage; do not invent explicit father reference.

rows.en: The elderly aren't the ones who create a new era.
I learned that from Kamille Bidan and Judau Ashta.
Captain Quattro...!
If the wise do not guide the foolish, humanity and the Earth Sphere itself will perish!
You should have learned that in the One Year War and the Gryps Conflict.
Then why don't you look for a method other than the Mass Driver?
What is the point of destroying Earth's environment and causing so many people to die?
The Mass Driver was used solely to give our forces an advantage in the opening battles,
rows.notes: Sentence split retained at same source boundary; purpose of initial deployment.

rows.en: and it serves no purpose beyond keeping the Federation forces in check.
rows.notes: Continuation of previous row, keep restraining Federation forces.

rows.en: As proof, Marshal Guiltorre has not authorized the Mass Driver's use since the opening battles.
That still doesn't guarantee you'll never use it again...!
The marshal sincerely thinks of the Earth Sphere's future! And our goal is not to destroy Earth's environment!
rows.notes: Marshal's sincerity claim and negated environmental-destruction objective retained.

rows.en: Our goal is to purge the incompetent bureaucrats infesting our mother planet!
rows.notes: Purge and incompetent/infesting carry source ideological contempt.

rows.en: So you're saying attacks by the Mass Driver are the pain necessary to bring about a new era...!?
rows.notes: Amuro rejects necessary-pain justification for Mass Driver attacks.

rows.en: But all you're doing is laying the groundwork for a dictatorship.
How could self-righteous reforms by a handful of people ever guide people's hearts?
rows.notes: Rhetorical negative preserves inability to guide people's hearts, not literal request.

rows.en: You're pointing your blades at the wrong people...!
How could a regime built under cover of chaos ever lead people in a better direction!?
...It seems you and I are incompatible after all...!
But they did hit a bit of a sore spot, didn't they?
rows.notes: Saburota suggests their arguments exposed Meio's doubt.

rows.en: What did you say...?
...Wasn't it precisely because you had doubts in your heart that you questioned us?
rows.notes: Rom explicitly links questioning them to internal doubt.

rows.en: There is... no doubt in my heart!
Then what will you do, Meio Plato!?
You needn't ask...! I'll slay you here!
rows.notes: Threat uses slay for source defeat/kill in battle.

rows.en: Very well! We'll smash you and your doubts together with our fists!
rows.notes: Smash Meio together with doubts; fists plural collective preserved.

rows.en: Captain, we have four minutes left until the time limit!
We should start hurrying now...
Three minutes left until the time limit!
We're running out of time. Hurry and open a way through, then head to the target point.
rows.notes: Ruri instructs breakthrough then target point; restore movement action.

rows.en: Two minutes left until the time limit! Things are starting to get dangerous!
It's all right. Let's trust everyone.
W-we only have thirty seconds left! Captaaaain!!
Harry, have you already forgotten... what Captain Amuro said?
rows.notes: Ruri refers to Amuro's earlier beyond-your-best advice; Harry body, Hari prefill maintained.

rows.en: Y-you mean, do better than our best...!?
rows.notes: Recalls Amuro source499 best-above-best exhortation; quoted instruction becomes indirect recall with restored our.

rows.en: That's right. You mustn't give up until the very end.
I-it's no good, Captain! We won't be able to break through at this rate!!
rows.notes: Repeated failure message used at392 and394; retain one row.

rows.en: ...It seems we'll have to try again. If we have the time to do that, that is...
rows.notes: Repeated retry response at393 and395; shared wording applies to both.

rows.en: We did it, Captain! We've reached the target point!
All units... Please leave this sector at full speed.
Nadesico will continue at maximum battle speed toward the Moon's Spiral Castle sector.
rows.notes: Spiral Castle is lunar destination, not ordinary castle metaphor.

rows.en: All right! Just you wait, Lagowe! I'm coming for you now, you bastard!!
rows.notes: Aggressive threat and rude second-person language carried by you bastard. Meaning review restores singular Ginga subject I, rather than initial collective we.

rows.en: To think I couldn't stop them...!
Was there... doubt in my heart...?
rows.notes: Recalls Rom confronting Meio about doubt in source627-631.

rows.en: You're in pain, aren't you, Unicorn...?
rows.notes: Addresses Unicorn after deduplicated silence ownerStage07:265 at i06s1a:0.
Leo Circle remains silent across repeated appearances.

rows.en: Leo is so weak now, too...
rows.notes: Leo counterpart after deduplicated silence ownerStage08:406 at i06s1a:2.

rows.en: The defense program has reached its limit, too. The virus will resume its advance soon...
What will happen then...!?
I've prepared countermeasures, but they're only a stopgap now...
If those fail, the virus will completely destroy Unicorn and Leo's data.
rows.notes: Plural Unicorn and Leo settled by two afflicted Data Weapons in scene.

rows.en: And the Data Weapons will disappear...
Don't give up, Eris! My brother and everyone else are fighting to save Leo and Unicorn!
rows.notes: Leina source brother reference retained; plural Leo and Unicorn restored.

rows.en: So you mustn't give up until the very end, either...! Let's do our best to save them both!
rows.notes: Two refers to Leo and Unicorn; encouragement asks Eris to persist alongside Leina.

rows.en: ...Yes...! I believe in Ginga and Hokuto, too...!
! The defense program has been breached! The virus has resumed its advance!
Set everything from W115 onward to pattern D! Activate defense program Ver.1.2! Then activate Counter Protect!
rows.notes: Rear/after direction rendered onward, avoiding initial back to that could imply reverting to a pattern. Root confirms literal source-only defense program, Counter Protect and ASCII identifiers W115, pattern D, Ver.1.2; no technical mechanism inferred.

rows.en: Hurry, big brother... At this rate, Leo and Unicorn will...
rows.notes: Thought; Leina addresses brother Rom; consequence trails off intentionally.

rows.en: So Dendoh and those wretched humans are coming...
rows.notes: Machine commander contempt for humans preserved.

rows.en: Yes...! We thought they would join the fighting between the humans on the Moon, but...
rows.notes: Report trails after contrast but, followed by665.

rows.en: They appear to be heading for this Spiral Castle.
Damn Dendoh... You challenge us to battle without two of your Data Weapons...?
Lagowe has begun rampaging, perhaps sensing Dendoh's approach.
rows.notes: Dendoh is approaching referent; causal perhaps preserves source speculation.

rows.en: This is...
rows.notes: Deliberate stunned fragment continued by669.

rows.en: The Machine Beasts are being devoured at an incredible rate...!
Damn Lagowe... It must want food to heal the wounds from its last battle.
We have no choice... We'll keep Core 258 sealed off.
rows.notes: Core258 is sealed section holding Machine Beasts and Lagowe.

rows.en: Th-then what will happen to the Machine Beasts inside...!?
Which would you prefer? His Majesty learning of Lagowe's wounds, or feeding it two or three hundred Machine Beasts...?
rows.notes: Source 2,300 means two or three hundred, not2300; cruel feeding choice retained.

rows.en: You're right...
If His Majesty learns that Lagowe suffered such an ordeal...
rows.notes: Conditional trails into676 across speakers.

rows.en: We'll be punished, too...
rows.notes: Restored we and punishment action; clause answers675.
